aiAnalysis.finding: Front left strut mount assembly shows significant structural play and bearing failure.
aiAnalysis.recommendation: REPLACE — Critical for noise reduction and steering stability. Use OEM Revised Kit per TSB 54-ST-013H.
aiAnalysis.reasoning: Visual inspection and tactile test confirm bearing seizure and rubber degradation. Correlates with customer complaint of 'clunking' over bumps. Hyundai TSB 54-ST-013H specifically addresses this component failure on 2022-2023 models.

aiAnalysis.finding: Front right strut mount assembly shows significant structural play.
aiAnalysis.recommendation: REPLACE — Critical for noise reduction and steering stability. Use OEM Revised Kit per TSB 54-ST-013H.
aiAnalysis.reasoning: Mirroring the LH side, the RH mount shows similar bearing wear and structural instability. Both sides must be replaced to ensure even ride height and damping.

items.name: Front Sway Bar End Links — Both Sides

aiAnalysis.finding: Front sway bar end links exhibit significant lateral play in the ball joints.
aiAnalysis.recommendation: REPLACE — Both sides required to eliminate chassis rattle and stabilize cornering.
aiAnalysis.reasoning: Physical inspection shows boot tearing and excessive movement in the link joints. This is a primary source of the 'rattle' reported during chassis inspection.

aiAnalysis.finding: Steering rack bellows/boots are intact with no signs of grease leakage.
aiAnalysis.reasoning: Visual inspection shows rubber is supple and no hydraulic fluid is present on the boot surfaces.

aiAnalysis.finding: Front brake pads are at 50% life with 6mm remaining.
aiAnalysis.recommendation: MONITOR — Replace during next scheduled service interval.
aiAnalysis.reasoning: Measurement taken via caliper. Wear is even. Sufficient thickness remains for current driving conditions.
